title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：queen　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 queen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the clerk ① crowned the queen that no applicant in the office would have measured, and he said the crowning was the whole of the month. The ② queen, meaning the ruler itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a queen, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ queen in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ queen at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A queen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the clerk said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the queen was the whole of the matter, meaning the dignity and not the ruler. The ⑥ queen, meaning the dignity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; queen, he said, is either something you crown or the only word that means both a ruler and a dignity. He said the dignity is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ queen had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ queen of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of measuring; queen, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ queen I remember is the ruler measured in the file, which closed in 1977 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ queen, my mother said in 1979, is the only ruler that improves by being measured; every queen, she said, is a dignity that has agreed to look like a ruler. She said the dignity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 女王；王后（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 女王；王后（指那位女王本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：crown the queen 加冕这一位女王
D. n. 女王；王后（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 女王之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的女王之事）
F. n. 女王；王后（指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 女王、威仪（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 威仪（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crowned the queen that no applicant in the office would have measured
The queen, meaning the ruler itself and not the stamp
the queen at the far counter
the queen was the whole of the matter
the queen had become a line in a file
The queen of the whole thing
A queen, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: crown the queen 意为“加冕这一位女王”，1970 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯测量的一位女王做了一遍。
queen 意为“女王；王后”，指那位女王本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
queen 意为“女王；王后”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
queen 意为“女王；王后”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
queen 意为“女王、威仪”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位威仪就是那件事的全部。
queen 意为“威仪”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位女王，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
queen 意为“女王；王后”，指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1975 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
queen 意为“女王之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的女王之事是一处办事处和三个月份的测量。
queen 意为“女王；王后”，我记得的是卷宗里测量过的那一位，1977 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
queen 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，女王是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的女王。
